text_block_list.text:
The day of the Spring Stakes. Normally,
it 
would be a race full of excitement, but...

With so many Umamusume avoiding a
showdown 
with Maruzensky, the race was barely able 
to proceed with the absolute minimum 
number of runners.

Even so, Maruzensky headed off to the 
track, determined to have fun out there.
